title: Workmanship Warranties Plan Schedule: Plans, Source Work and Issue Terms
content:
Crestline issues six Workmanship Warranties plans. Each plan is issued on one kind of finished network work, named below as its source work, and each carries the same issue terms set out in this schedule.

## Plans and the source work each is issued on

| Plan | Source work the plan is issued on |
|---|---|
| Chip Repair Guarantee | Windshield Chip Repair completed |
| Calibration Workmanship Warranty | calibration order completed |
| Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Paintless Dent Repair Service or Cosmetic Touch-Up Service delivered |
| Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | glass replacement completed |
| Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | non-structural insurance claim repair, or Bumper Refinish, Panel Repair, Customer-Pay Collision or Complete Refinish service, delivered |
| Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty | Structural, Certified Structural or Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair delivered |

## Issue terms by plan

| Term | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coverages one delivered or completed source job may carry | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| How the warranty certificate is delivered | email | email | email | email | email | email |
| Any network center honors the coverage | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Parts the customer supplied are excluded from coverage | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Sensors whose calibration the customer declined are excluded from coverage | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Reading the schedule

- **Coverages per source job.** The figure is the number of coverages one delivered or completed source job may carry; under every plan it is 1.
- **Certificate delivery.** The plan states how the warranty certificate is delivered; under every plan the channel is email.
- **Nationwide service.** Where the entry is yes, any network center honors the coverage; the entry is yes under every plan.
- **Customer-supplied parts and declined calibrations.** Where the entry is yes, parts the customer supplied, and sensors whose calibration the customer declined, are excluded from coverage under that plan; both entries are yes under every plan.

Q. Does a Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty carry a different certificate channel from a Chip Repair Guarantee?
A. No. Every plan in the schedule delivers its certificate by email.

Q. Can one completed calibration order carry two Calibration Workmanship Warranty coverages?
A. No. The figure for every plan, including the Calibration Workmanship Warranty, is 1 coverage per delivered or completed source job.
